blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—The International Criminal Court (ICC) states that its work as a court of last resort is not politically motivated. At the same time, it called on its own members to make sure that it is able to continue discharging its mandate in the wake of fresh sanctions from the United States. Judge Tomoko Akane, the ICC president, on Saturday maintained that the tribunal based in The Hague is independent and impartial. Her action comes after the US Department of State announced moves aimed at restricting US companies from transacting with the court. This is on top of the sanctions the […]...
